newsitem.title: SWEDEN: FORECAST - SCA H1 seen 1.77 bln skr.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - SCA H1 seen 1.77 bln skr.

text.p: Swedish forestry group SCA is expected to post a profit after financial net of 1.77 billion crowns for the first half of the year, a Reuter poll of 13 analysts showed on Monday.
This would mean a 40 percent fall on the profit of 2.95 billion crowns posted for the same 1995 period.
The forecasts ranged between 1.60 billion and 2.00 billion crowns, with a median value of 1.78 billion.
Estimates for calendar 1996 indicate a profit after financial net of 3.54 billion crowns, a forecast which has fallen by 410 million crowns since the last Reuter poll in mid-May.
SCA is due to post its figures for the first half on Thursday.
